label: Recorded vote
notes: High weight. A recorded UN vote on a similar resolution.

label: Official statement
notes: High weight. Statement in GA debate or national policy.

label: Bloc position
notes: Medium weight. Applied to each member scaled by the bloc's cohesion.

label: Class intel
notes: Medium weight at a conference. What a delegate said in caucus. The source is who said it and when.

label: AI estimate
notes: Low weight. Only counted with at least one source; otherwise stored as unknown.

label: Voting history
notes: Weight comes from the number of past votes (model parameters), not this column.

label: Unsourced note
notes: Hand-entered judgements carried over from the v2 pack (overrides). Weight 2 until a source is attached; facts with no position do not move the estimate.
